text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide suffered defeat in the 
Kikuka Sho. Yet,
having poured every ounce 
of herself into her desire to win, her 
expression showed that she had accepted 
the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race,
Narita Taishin and Winning 
Ticket appear to praise each other's 
valiant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next race is the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
It was decided that she would have her 
rematch against Narita Taishin there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide declared that she would win 
next time.
Her smile was far brighter than 
before.
